senses.gloss_en: US: with whom one shares an apartment or house
coercion (forcing or pressuring someone to do something)
supporting (playing a role that is not the lead but which still represents a major character)
to harmonize, to combine (different or opposite things)
to coalesce (to join into a single mass)
(transitive) pass a liquid through a porous substance
coarctation; stenosis (abnormal narrowing or stricture in a blood vessel or other tubular organ)
to cosign (to sign a document jointly with another person)
coauthorship (authorship by two or more authors)
the sound of a frog or toad
